summary: Platform & DevSecOps engineer who designs and runs Kubernetes/OpenShift at scale, provisions everything as code, and operates large GitOps and CI/CD pipelines with security baked in. I run the cloud-native platform behind Slovakia's national e-government today, and have operated AWS infrastructure at SaaS scale — comfortable owning reliability, observability and developer experience across an enterprise estate.

experience.name: NASES — National e-Government Platform
bullets: Design and operate multi-cluster Kubernetes/OpenShift, provisioned fully as code with Terraform/OpenTofu across cloud and bare-metal.
Run a large GitOps platform on self-managing Argo CD, with Helm-packaged workloads across the whole estate.
Own end-to-end observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), secrets (Vault), identity (Keycloak) and network policy (Cilium).
Bake supply-chain security and policy gates into GitLab CI/CD so issues are caught before release.

experience.name: LiveAgent
bullets: Operated the AWS + Terraform infrastructure and scaling behind a SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies — caching (Redis), search (ElasticSearch), messaging and workers.
Helped lead development across feature work, architecture and the DevOps underneath, on the leadership team for two years.

experience.name: Medical Navigator
bullets: Deployed a multilingual platform to AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB, via a multi-account Terraform setup driven entirely by GitHub Actions.

experience.name: DXC Technology
bullets: Built and shipped an internal web app end to end on a two-person team — build through containerised deployment (Docker, Azure).
